_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: How far do you want to progress during this playthrough?
The selected chapter defines the maximum intended progression.
Items and Locations found beyond the selected chapter will be removed from the generation.
'Finale' is just a nickname for the final chapter of the game!
When enabled, will make Ores be randomized in the Multiworld and be required for crafting.
You are not allowed to mine the specific ores without these items.
When enabled, will add a location for each photo in the Photo Album.
When enabled, will add the city hall upgrades as locations.
Will also create a <3 item for each Character you can befriend, inspired by the Stardew Apworld.
These hearts are required before raising their friendship levels is in logic as to not overwhelm people too early with the grind.
